title: Eternal Childhood
description: A datapack that keeps your animals to be a baby forever using nametags
body:
You love the new baby animals in update 26.1? However they will have to grow up eventually...

Unless if you install this datapack! You can make animals be a child forever by naming them Agnes_. Effect last permanently even after you change their name to something else, except Notch_ because naming animals with this removes the effect, and your animal will grow up normally after 20 minutes.

Naming an adult animal Agnes_ also convert them into a child.

Use /trigger eterchi_help to remind yourself about the names :3
